Allow BIGIP to work with non rfc compliant CE devices which ignore BR prefix lengths. The default is to disable.

BR (Border Relay) prefix and netmask for MAP-T domain. The default prefix length is 96.

32

Specifies EA (Embedded Address) length of the MAP-T domain. The default is 32 (IPv4 24 bits + PSID 8 bits).
ip4Prefix
string
optional
read/write
Rule IPv4 prefix and netmask for MAP-T domain CE (Customer Edge) devices. The default prefix length is 8.
ip6Prefix
string
optional
read/write
Rule IPv6 prefix and netmask for MAP-T domain CE (Customer Edge) devices. The default prefix length is 48.
